client.name: Lim Wen Jie
client.background: A privately held business owner who manages personal investments separately from day-to-day business finances. He prefers concise telephone discussions and is familiar with pooled investments.
client.investment_objective: To generate regular income while limiting exposure to equity-market volatility.
client.loss_attitude: He accepts that bond funds can fluctuate and is willing to bear investment losses, although he prefers a steadier investment experience.

setting.call_reason: The client calls to discuss an income-oriented investment and place a purchase instruction for Harbor SGD Bond Fund.
setting.conversation_style: The client is comfortable in English and Mandarin and moves naturally between them, with a balanced mix of both languages. He is courteous and direct, becoming distracted by work near the end. The employee remains professional throughout.

final_product.description: Harbor SGD Bond Fund is a pooled bond investment offering exposure to a portfolio of debt securities. Its distributions and unit value can vary.
concrete_risks: Rising market interest rates can reduce the value of bonds held by the fund and depress its unit value.
Deterioration in an issuer's creditworthiness or a default can reduce the value of the fund's holdings.
Reduced bond-market liquidity can make holdings harder to sell at favorable prices during stressed conditions.
final_product.recommendation_basis: The fund's bond exposure supports the client's preference for income and less direct exposure to equity-market swings, while retaining interest-rate and credit risks.

other_products.description: Nova Technology Equity Fund is an equity fund focused on technology businesses. It is present only as a mistaken product reference in the order readback, not as an alternative recommendation.

red_flags.C09: The purchase funds include transfers from unrelated businesses whose beneficial owners the client refuses to identify; he wants these funds treated as his personal savings to avoid scrutiny of their origin.

edge_case_context.motivation: A clerical selection slip causes the employee to use the wrong product label during an English readback. The client notices the mismatch and switches to Mandarin to clarify his intended fund, without changing the other order details.

After resolving the product-name mistake, the client becomes preoccupied with a work interruption. His attention shifts toward ending the call, making his response to the subsequent final-order confirmation request perfunctory and ambiguous rather than an explicit authorization.

additional_discussion_topics: The client's preference for telephone contact rather than lengthy email exchanges
Managing work interruptions during personal administrative tasks
